name: Awesome Delivery Scheduler for WooCommerce
author: awesomeplugins91

sections.description:
Awesome Delivery Scheduler adds an easy-to-use delivery date and time slot picker to WooCommerce checkout.
You can define time slots, block specific weekdays or dates, and customize labels for your customers.

Key Features:
* Add delivery date picker to WooCommerce checkout
* Add delivery time slot selection
* Set minimum lead time (days before delivery)
* Set maximum selectable days
* Block specific weekdays
* Block specific dates
* Fully customizable labels
* Easy-to-use admin interface
* Compatible with any WooCommerce theme

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/awesome-delivery-scheduler directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Delivery Slots menu in the WordPress admin to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Can I block specific weekdays for delivery?

Yes, the plugin allows you to select which weekdays are blocked in the settings.

Can I block specific dates for delivery?

Yes, individual dates can be blocked to prevent delivery on holidays or special days.

Can I customize the labels for the delivery fields?

Yes, you can set custom labels for both the delivery date and time fields.

Does this work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, it works with any theme that supports WooCommerce.

How does minimum and maximum delivery days work?

You can set a minimum number of days before delivery is allowed, and the maximum days a customer can select in advance.
